item.title: {openexr_2,ilmbase}: Replace meta.insecure with meta.knownVulnerabilities
item.description:
meta.insecure is not a thing, and has never properly warned users about these packages being insecure. meta.insecure is always overwritten to be based on meta.knownVulnerabilities being non-empty (input meta.insecure is not considered), so this doesn't prevent these packages from being built and used.

https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/23f10970547b5c953f4d2a95d308f8f51a7e1f81/pkgs/stdenv/generic/check-meta.nix#L641 https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/23f10970547b5c953f4d2a95d308f8f51a7e1f81/pkgs/stdenv/generic/check-meta.nix#L138

These attributes were added in #367406 before 25.05, so needs backporting to stable. openexr_2 is still being pulled into current gimp via gegl, so switch that one to the unpinned openexr.
